{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Sheath dress, midi length, midnight blue, silk crepe.
Tailored wool-blend blazer, cropped jacket silhouette, charcoal grey, fine tweed.
Block-heel pumps, pointed toe, metallic gold, smooth leather.
Delicate pearl drop earrings, single strand cultured pearl necklace, slim gold watch with a leather strap.

This outfit works perfectly for an upscale wedding reception in autumn, balancing the required formal dress code with seasonal warmth and elegance. The midnight blue sheath dress provides a sophisticated base that honors the ceremony's significance without appearing too heavy for a midday event under daylight. Adding the structured charcoal blazer offers necessary coverage against cooler fall air while maintaining a polished business-appropriate silhouette suitable for a restaurant setting. Finally, the metallic gold shoes and pearls introduce a subtle celebratory sparkle that respects the occasion's joyous nature without overwhelming the refined atmosphere."}
